reuse.why: Reuses tag parsing, budget writes, batching and average calculation, but the new spending action bypasses the existing spreadsheet spending totals.

duplication.why: Consolidates the month-average actions while duplicating spending aggregation, template eligibility and the average-to-budget conversion.

placement.why: Eligibility and action registration fit their existing modules, although spending aggregation duplicates logic owned by the budget spreadsheet layer.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration and relevant tests.

maintainability.why: The shared eligibility predicate and average runner improve ownership, but parallel spending calculations and redundant eligibility checks leave multiple definitions to maintain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts:setLastMonthSpending queries transaction totals directly instead of reading the sum-amount cells through getSheetValue, as existing spending consumers do.

disguised_duplication.where: setLastMonthSpending reshapes base.ts spending aggregation into a single-month query; setMonthAverage repeats setNMonthAvg's average/sign/write sequence; getMonthActionCategories repeats the predicate's template exclusion in SQL.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared eligibility predicate gains the requested includeHiddenCategories override; setLastMonthSpending introduces a separate spending calculation that bypasses spreadsheet totals.
